title: Highmoor Rising
premise: Petra Dunmore, a mercenary bound by oath to the silent god Veyl, keeps the ledgers of the Gilded Ledger guild, which trades in impossible things: stolen memories, bottled grief, second chances. When she finds tonight's date inscribed in a century-old book of prophecies, she learns the guild's founder wrote her own fate long before her birth. As the usurper's armies march on the free cities, Petra discovers the secret the ledgers protect: Veyl's silence was caused by the founder sealing the god's voice inside a mortal vessel, and that vessel is Petra herself. In the end, Petra must choose between speaking the god's name and unleashing an ancient war, or surrendering her own memories of everyone she loves to keep the seal intact; she chooses sacrifice, but the woman who wakes remembers only the ledger, and begins writing a new prophecy of her own.
about_author: Ines Coldharbour is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing the correspondence of failed merchant houses before turning to fiction. She writes in a drafty coastal house, fuelled by ledger ink, black tea, and a conviction that every debt comes due.

chapters.title: The Ledger of Small Debts
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. She balances the guild's accounts of impossible trades while hiding her mercenary past and her silent god's mark. When a client trades a memory of tomorrow, Petra recognizes the date in her own handwriting. Emotional beat: quiet unease, the first crack in her carefully invisible life.

chapters.title: A Century of Tomorrows
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. In the guild vault she finds the founder's prophecy book and her own name beside tonight's date. Her handler, Sable, warns her to burn it. Emotional beat: dread curdling into defiance as Petra realizes the founder knew her before she was born.

chapters.title: The Usurper's Coin
chapters.summary: Dual POV, Petra and the usurper's spymaster Corvane. A guild broker is found dead with usurper coin in his mouth, signaling the free cities are infiltrated. Petra's POV: she recognizes the coin's mint-mark as Veyl's old sigil. Emotional beat: grief and guilt over a death she might have prevented.

chapters.title: What the River Remembers
chapters.summary: Petra's POV, with a flashback to her mercenary years. She seeks the river-oracle Maren, who traded away her own past, and learns the god's silence began the night Petra swore her oath. Emotional beat: vertigo, the suspicion that her survival came at someone else's cost.

chapters.title: Love Against the Ledger
chapters.summary: Petra and Ilse, the guild's memory-keeper, grow closer as Ilse helps Petra decode the prophecy in stolen fragments. Their tenderness contrasts with the guild's rule against attachment. Emotional beat: warmth and fear, because the prophecy names 'the beloved' as the seal's first payment.

chapters.title: The Silent God Speaks
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. During a raid on the guild, Veyl's voice finally returns through Petra's own mouth, speaking a warning she doesn't understand. Corvane captures Sable. Emotional beat: terror and awe; Petra learns the god's voice lives inside her.

chapters.title: The Founder's Bargain
chapters.summary: Ilse's POV, then Petra's. In the founder's hidden chapel, they learn the truth: the founder sealed Veyl into a bloodline of vessels, and Petra is the last. Speaking the god's name reignites the old war; staying silent erodes the seal, feeding the usurper's power. Emotional beat: betrayal, then resolve.

chapters.title: Armies at the Salt Gate
chapters.summary: Multi-POV. The usurper's host reaches the free cities' walls; Corvane offers Petra a bargain: surrender the god and Ilse lives. The guild fractures, half its brokers defecting. Emotional beat: desperation and clarity; Petra sees every path costs someone she loves.

chapters.title: The Name in the Ink
chapters.summary: Petra's POV, climax. On the walls at dawn, Petra speaks Veyl's name to shatter the usurper's claim to divine right, reigniting the ancient war but breaking his army's momentum. Ilse takes the seal's payment in her place. Emotional beat: sacrifice, fury, and heartbreak intertwined.

chapters.title: A New Ledger
chapters.summary: Ilse's POV, then Petra's. The cities hold, the war simmers, and Petra wakes with her memories of love and loss traded away, remembering only the ledgers. She begins writing in a blank prophecy book. Emotional beat: bittersweet hope, the price paid, and a new debt beginning.
